title: Add the rating UI to the References tab: decision, confidence, thumbs, reason and explanation
description:
In components/newsroom-references-view.tsx, for each pending Reference show the decision and confidence (for example Include, 82% sure) and why it was picked for review, and add a Needs review filter first in the status tabs. Replace the Accept/Reject pair with the Cyclotron review control (decision-flywheel-dd270031) in thumbs mode: thumbs up accepts; thumbs down asks for a reason from REFERENCE_REJECTION_REASON_CODES (out of scope and policy exclusion mean exclude; duplicate, low quality, unavailable, provenance and other mean no label) and an optional explanation, plus a shareable checkbox. Archive stays. Wire onReview through runReferenceCurationAction in components/topic-steering-workspace.tsx, which today drops note and reasonCode for this tab. Ordering: after the data model and the pipeline hook; needs the Cyclotron package release (decision-flywheel-0dafa816).

Acceptance criteria:
- A review from the tab stores the reason, explanation, shareable flag and decisionRelationId through reviewReferenceCuration.
- Items with no decision still work exactly as today.
- Demo mode renders with fixture decisions and no network.
- Vitest and the existing newsroom BDD features cover thumbs up, thumbs down with each reason class, and undo.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented on feature/PPY-820acd-cyclotron-review-ui (built on PPY-7a1ca2). The References tab shows each decided reference's decision and confidence in the list, a Needs review filter first, and in the detail the Cyclotron ReviewControl (cyclotron ui-v0.2.0 tarball, transpilePackages, components.css in the Newsroom layout) in thumbs mode with Papyrus's existing rejection reasons only (out_of_scope and policy_exclusion teach; the others close without a label), an explanation, and a shareable checkbox. Reviews go through reviewReferenceCuration with decisionRelationId and shareable. References without a decision keep Accept/Reject/Archive. The review control mode is per cyclotron (relevanceCyclotron.reviewControl) and travels in the decision metadata. Demo mode has a fixture decision. Specs: features/newsroom-reference-relevance.feature 4/4 against a local dev server (demo mode), scripts/test-relevance-review-ui.ts and test-relevance-decisions.ts (in test:ci:ts), backend config scenarios 7/7; typecheck and eslint clean; next build compiles (page-data collection needs cloud credentials, as on develop). Two existing reference scenarios in newspaper-layout.feature fail the same way with and without this change. Note: ReviewControl uses useId, which this page numbers differently on server and client; the control renders in the browser only until the engine derives ids from item and decision.

right_now_summary: The References tab now shows decisions and supports thumbs-up or thumbs-down reviews with reasons and explanations.
